headlines.title: Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac Are No-Shows at Conventions
headlines.abstract: The two troubled mortgage lenders won’t be sponsoring events, as they had in previous cycles.

headlines.title: Mortgage Giant Overstated the Size of Its Capital Base
headlines.abstract: Advisers poring over the books of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac concluded that Freddie’s accounting methods had overstated its cushion, officials said.
